timestamp_gap_audit.candidate_semantics: allows up to two missing nominal 10s samples; larger gaps invalidate causal trial continuity

two_minute_stability_audit.candidate_basis: approximately the median 2-minute pH range among stable-flow windows whose outlet SO2 first-last change is <=2 mg/Nm3

strict_low_disturbance_noise_windows.method: absolute difference between first-minute and second-minute medians inside each independent 2-minute window

five_minute_identification_baseline_audi.reason: Only three independent 300-second windows satisfy the identification-like baseline filters; their quantiles would be unstable and must not be used as a site threshold.

review_implications.min_effect_rule: reviewed minimum effect must be explicitly selected above the empirical low-disturbance noise floor; this audit does not choose the safety multiplier
notes: The 43 strict 2-minute noise windows expose an empirical noise floor but do not define a production confidence multiplier by themselves.
Historical CSV lacks the runtime outlet_so2_target needed to reconstruct strict Qbase proximity, so max_abs_actual_minus_qbase cannot be calibrated from this file alone.
The inlet-SO2 <=50 mg/Nm3 condition is part of the strict 2-minute noise selection and therefore cannot be claimed as newly estimated from that same selected subset.
A separate 300-second baseline audit found only three qualifying independent windows; max_abs_inlet_so2_change therefore remains null rather than publishing unstable P90/P95 values.
All values remain audit/review candidates; no runtime or manual test permission is granted.
